build_metric_depth_head: build a VitMetricDepthHead with deconv layers and configurable upsample factor for metric depth prediction
create_deconv_layers: create deconvolutional upsample layers with kernel sizes 2, 3, or 4 using _make_deconv_layers
create_conv_layers: create convolutional layers with InstanceNorm2d and SiLU activation using _make_conv_layers
run_forward_depth_prediction: run forward pass through the depth head to predict metric depth maps from ViT features
compute_depth_loss: compute depth prediction loss by comparing seg_logits against ground truth depth maps
